title: Labels for the Market Stall

readiness.reading: hearing the first sound of a word (younger); reading short sound-by-sound words (older)

concepts: labels tell us what things are

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Good morning! People ask me, "What is in that jar? What is in that bowl?" Labels would help them.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Tap a picture to hear its name. Then find the label that goes under it.

older.prompt: Read each label. Tap it to hear its sounds, then put it under the right picture.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Listen to each name. Which letter makes its first sound? Put that letter under the picture.

feedback.all_good: Every jar and basket has its label. Thank you!

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Now everyone can see what's what. Thank you kindly!

journal_line: I made labels for Mr. Tobias's market stall, listening for the sounds in each name.
unavailable_text: Mr. Tobias's stall already has its labels.
